description_en: Queries all access control policies of the specified virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls
description_zh: 查询指定的VPC边界防火墙的所有访问控制策略信息
name: DescribeVpcFirewallControlPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response.

Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

zh（默认）：中文

en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Valid values:

If the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls protect traffic between two VPCs connected by CEN, set this parameter to the instance ID of the CEN instance.

If the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls protect traffic between two VPCs connected by Express Connect, set this parameter to the instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159760.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的实例ID。取值：

当VPC边界防火墙防护通过云企业网连接的两个VPC之间的流量时，该参数值使用云企业网实例ID。

当VPC边界防火墙防护通过高速通道连接的两个VPC之间的流量时，该参数值使用VPC边界防火墙实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159760.html接口获取该ID
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the current page for a paged query.
You must specify both CurrentPage and PageSize or omit both. If you specify only one of them, the operation returns the ErrorParametersPageSizeOrNo (400) error
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，设置当前页的页码。
CurrentPage 与 PageSize 必须同时提供或同时省略。若仅提供其中一个，接口将返回 ErrorParametersPageSizeOrNo (400) 错误
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The number of access control policies of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls to return on each page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 50.

You must specify both CurrentPage and PageSize or omit both. If you specify only one of them, the operation returns the ErrorParametersPageSizeOrNo (400) error
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，设置每页包含VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略数量。

可设置值最大为50。

CurrentPage 与 PageSize 必须同时提供或同时省略。若仅提供其中一个，接口将返回 ErrorParametersPageSizeOrNo (400) 错误
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The source address in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Fuzzy match is supported.

Source can be a single CIDR block or an address book name
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中的访问源地址。支持使用模糊查询。

Source可以是单个CIDR地址或地址簿名称
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The destination address in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Fuzzy match is supported.

Destination can be a single CIDR block, a domain name, or an address book name
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中的目的地址。支持模糊查询。

Destination可以是单个CIDR地址或域名，也可以是地址薄名称
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en: The description of the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略的描述信息。支持模糊查询
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type of the traffic in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Valid values:

TCP
UDP
ICMP
ANY: all protocol types.

If you do not specify this parameter, all protocol types are queried
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中访问流量的协议类型。取值：

TCP
UDP
ICMP
ANY（查询所有协议类型）

不设置该参数表示查询所有协议类型
parameters.name: proto

parameters.help_en:
The action that Cloud Firewall performs on the traffic in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Valid values:

accept: allows the traffic.
drop: denies the traffic.
log: monitors the traffic.

If you do not specify this parameter, all actions are queried
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中设置的访问流量通过云防火墙的方式（动作）。取值：

accept：放行
drop：拒绝
log：观察

不设置该参数表示查询所有动作
parameters.name: acl_action

parameters.help_en: The UID of the member account of the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号UID
parameters.name: member_uid

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls
parameters.help_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略的唯一标识ID
parameters.name: acl_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The enabling status of the access control policy. Valid values:

true: The access control policy is enabled.
false: The access control policy is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的启用状态。取值：

true：启用访问控制策略
false：不启用访问控制策略
parameters.name: release

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence type of the policy validity period for the access control policy. Valid values:
Permanent (default): always.
None: a specific single time.
Daily: every day.
Weekly: every week.
Monthly: every month
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复类型。取值：
Permanent（默认）：总是
None：指定单次时间
Daily：每天
Weekly：每周
Monthly：每月
parameters.name: repeat_type

Description.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略的描述信息

DestPort.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中访问流量的目的端口

DestPortGroup.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中访问流量的目的端口地址簿名称

DestPortGroupPorts.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中目的端口地址簿的详细信息

items.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中目的端口地址簿中包含的端口列表

DestPortType.description_en:
The type of the destination port for the traffic in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Valid values:
port: a single port.
group: a port address book
DestPortType.description_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中访问流量的目的端口类型。取值：
port：单个端口
group：端口地址簿

Destination.description_en:
The destination address in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Valid values:

If DestinationType is `net`, Destination is the destination CIDR block.

If DestinationType is `domain`, Destination is the destination domain name.

If DestinationType is `group`, Destination is the name of the destination address book
Destination.description_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中的目的地址。取值：

当DestinationType为`net`时，Destination为目的CIDR地址。

当DestinationType为`domain`时，Destination为目的域名。

当DestinationType为`group`时，Destination为目的地址簿名称

DestinationGroupCidrs.description_en: The CIDR block information in the destination address book of the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls
DestinationGroupCidrs.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中目的地址簿中的网段信息

items.description_en: The list of CIDR blocks in the destination address book of the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls
items.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中目的地址簿中的网段列表

DestinationGroupType.description_en:
The type of the destination address book in the access control policy. Valid values:

ip: an IP address book that contains one or more CIDR blocks.
domain: a domain name address book that contains one or more domain names
DestinationGroupType.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的目的地址簿类型。取值：

ip：IP地址簿，包含一个或多个IP地址段。
domain：域名地址簿，包含一个或多个域名地址

DestinationType.description_en:
The type of the destination address in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Valid values:

net: destination CIDR block.
group: destination address book.
domain: destination domain name
DestinationType.description_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中目的地址的类型。取值：

net：目的CIDR地址
group：目的地址簿
domain：目的域名

DomainResolveType.description_en:
The domain name resolution method of the access control policy. Valid values:

FQDN: FQDN-based resolution.
DNS: DNS-based dynamic resolution.
FQDN_AND_DNS: FQDN and DNS-based dynamic resolution
DomainResolveType.description_zh:
访问控制策略的域名解析方式。取值：

FQDN：基于FQDN
DNS：基于DNS动态解析
FQDN_AND_DNS：基于FQDN与DNS动态解析

EndTime.description_en:
The end time of the policy validity period for the access control policy. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time must be on the hour or half-hour, and it must be at least 30 minutes later than the start time.
If RepeatType is `Permanent`, EndTime is empty. If RepeatType is `None`, `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`, EndTime must be specified
EndTime.description_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。必须为整点或半点时间，且大于开始时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent时，EndTime为空。当RepeatType为None、Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，EndTime必须有值，您需要设置结束时间

HitLastTime.description_en: The latest hit timestamp. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
HitLastTime.description_zh: 最新命中时间戳。使用秒级时间戳格式表示

HitTimes.description_en: The number of hits of the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls
HitTimes.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略的命中次数

MemberUid.description_en: The UID of the member account of the current Alibaba Cloud account
MemberUid.description_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号UID

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the policy was modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
ModifyTime.description_zh: 修改策略的时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示

Order.description_en:
The priority of the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls.

The priority value starts from 1 and increments sequentially. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Order.description_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略生效的优先级。

优先级数字从1开始顺序递增，优先级数字越小，表示优先级越高

Proto.description_en:
The protocol type of the traffic in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Valid values:

TCP
UDP
ICMP
ANY: all protocol types
Proto.description_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中访问流量的协议类型。取值：

TCP
UDP
ICMP
ANY（表示查询所有协议类型）

Release.description_en:
The enabling status of the access control policy. By default, a policy is enabled after it is created. Valid values:

true: The access control policy is enabled.
false: The access control policy is disabled
Release.description_zh:
访问控制策略的启用状态。策略创建后默认启用该策略。取值：

true：启用访问控制策略
false：不启用访问控制策略

RepeatDays.description_en:
The set of recurrence days for the policy validity period of the access control policy.
If RepeatType is `Permanent`, `None`, or `Daily`, RepeatDays is an empty set.
  Example: []
If RepeatType is `Weekly`, RepeatDays cannot be empty.
  Example: [0, 6]
When RepeatType is `Weekly`, the values in RepeatDays must be unique.
If RepeatType is `Monthly`, RepeatDays cannot be empty.
  Example: [1, 31]
When RepeatType is `Monthly`, the values in RepeatDays must be unique
RepeatDays.description_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复日期集合。
当RepeatType为`Permanent`、`None`、`Daily`时，RepeatDays为空集合。
  例如：[]
当RepeatType为Weekly时，RepeatDays不能为空。
  例如：[0, 6]
RepeatType设置为Weekly时，RepeatDays不允许重复。
当RepeatType为`Monthly`时，RepeatDays不能为空。
  例如：[1, 31]
RepeatType设置为Monthly时，RepeatDays不允许重复

items.description_en:
The recurrence day for the policy validity period of the access control policy.
When RepeatType is `Weekly`, valid values are 0 to 6. A week starts on Sunday.
When RepeatType is `Monthly`, valid values are 1 to 31
items.description_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复日期。
RepeatType设置为Weekly时，取值范围：0~6，每周开始于周日。
RepeatType设置为Monthly时，取值范围：1~31

RepeatEndTime.description_en:
The recurrence end time when the policy takes effect. The time is in the 24-hour HH:mm format, such as 23:00.
If RepeatType is `Permanent` or `None`, RepeatEndTime is empty. If RepeatType is `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`, RepeatEndTime must be specified
RepeatEndTime.description_zh:
策略生效的重复结束时间。使用HH:mm格式的24小时制时间，如23:00。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatEndTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatEndTime必须有值，您需要设置重复结束时间

RepeatStartTime.description_en:
The recurrence start time when the policy takes effect. The time is in the 24-hour HH:mm format, such as 08:00.
If RepeatType is `Permanent` or `None`, RepeatStartTime is empty. If RepeatType is `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`, RepeatStartTime must be specified
RepeatStartTime.description_zh:
策略生效的重复开始时间。使用HH:mm格式的24小时制时间，如08:00。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatStartTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatStartTime必须有值，您需要设置重复开始时间

RepeatType.description_en:
The recurrence type of the policy validity period for the access control policy. Valid values:
Permanent (default): always.
None: a specific single time.
Daily: every day.
Weekly: every week.
Monthly: every month
RepeatType.description_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复类型。取值：
Permanent（默认）：总是
None：指定单次时间
Daily：每天
Weekly：每周
Monthly：每月

Source.description_en:
The source address in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Valid values:

If SourceType is `net`, Source is the source CIDR block.

If SourceType is `group`, Source is the name of the address book
Source.description_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中的访问源地址。取值：

当SourceType为`net`时，Source为访问源CIDR地址。

当SourceType为`group`时，Source为地址簿名称

SourceGroupCidrs.description_en: The details of the source address book in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls
SourceGroupCidrs.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中源地址簿的详细信息

items.description_en: The list of CIDR blocks in the source address book of the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls
items.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中，源地址簿中的网段列表

SourceGroupType.description_en: The type of the source address book in the access control policy. Valid value: ip, which indicates an IP address book that contains one or more CIDR blocks
SourceGroupType.description_zh: 访问控制策略中的源地址簿类型。唯一取值： ip。表示IP地址簿，包含一个或多个IP地址段

SourceType.description_en:
The type of the source address in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Valid values:

net: source CIDR block.
group: source address book
SourceType.description_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中源地址类型。取值：

net：源CIDR地址
group：源地址簿

SpreadCnt.description_en:
The number of access control policy quotas consumed. This value is the sum of the quotas consumed by each policy.
The number of quotas consumed by a single policy = Number of source CIDR blocks × Number of destination addresses (CIDR blocks or domain names) × Number of applications × Number of port ranges
SpreadCnt.description_zh:
占用访问控制策略的规格数，即每条策略占用规格数的累加值。
单条策略占用访问控制策略的规格数=访问源地址段个数 * 目的地址个数（IP地址段个数或域名个数）* 应用数 * 端口段个数

StartTime.description_en:
The start time of the policy validity period for the access control policy. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time must be on the hour or half-hour, and it must be at least 30 minutes earlier than the end time.
If RepeatType is `Permanent`, StartTime is empty. If RepeatType is `None`, `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`, StartTime must be specified
StartTime.description_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。必须为整点或半点时间，且小于结束时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent时，StartTime为空。当RepeatType为None、Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，StartTime必须有值，您需要设置开始时间

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of access control policies of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls
TotalCount.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略的总数量
